name: The War Games
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I — Each player creates three tapped 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens. The tokens are goaded for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield.
II, III — Put a +1/+1 counter on each Warrior creature.
IV — You may exile a nontoken creature you control. When you do, exile all Warriors.
blocked_sentences: I — Each player creates three tapped 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens. The tokens are goaded for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield.

needs.what: a goad duration tied to the source: the `goad` op with a clock like `duration: "while_source_on_battlefield"` (the O-Ring `until_leaves` link applied to goad), so the goad mark set by the Saga's controller ends exactly when the Saga leaves the battlefield and does not expire at the goader's next turn; applied to the tokens every player just created (an `as` binding over each player's create_token inside for_each_player)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_goad reads only `duration: "permanent"` (rest of the game) or the default 701.38 clock (until the goader's next turn); neither matches 'for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield' — the default ends a turn cycle early while the Saga sits at chapters II-IV, and permanent outlives the Saga's sacrifice after IV
